subject: remote-daemon-identity-custody
description: Pinned dependency provenance for the daemon remote identity custody adapters (macOS security-framework, Windows NCrypt via windows-sys, Linux/WSL cryptoki) and the p256 ECDSA low-S normalization + real-key test fake. Cross-checked against crates/cockpit-core/Cargo.toml and the workspace Cargo.lock by the test remote_daemon_identity_custody_provenance_matches_manifest.

dependencies.name: p256
dependencies.usage: DER->P1363 low-S normalization in every platform adapter; real p256 signing keys in the test fake.

dependencies.name: security-framework
dependencies.usage: Secure Enclave / Keychain nonexportable P-256 custody adapter (macOS).

dependencies.name: security-framework-sys
dependencies.usage: Low-level SecKey/SecAccessControl constants for the macOS adapter.

dependencies.name: cryptoki
dependencies.usage: PKCS#11 nonexportable P-256 custody adapter loading only an explicitly configured absolute module path (Linux/WSL). NOTE: not yet present in Cargo.lock at authoring time — the cargo gate must refresh the lock (cargo fetch / cargo build) before running with --locked.

dependencies.name: windows-sys
dependencies.usage: NCrypt (CNG) key-storage APIs for the Windows adapter; the Win32_Security_Cryptography feature was added by this workflow to the existing workspace-pinned windows-sys 0.61.2.
